title: Auto Parts Supplier for Nigeria | Autologic Industries
description: Autologic Industries is an auto parts supplier for Nigeria, exporting clutch, brake and die-cast parts for motorcycles, keke tricycles and assemblers.
banner_desc: Clutch, brake and casting components exported from India for Nigerian importers, traders and assemblers.
hero_sub: Twenty Product Lines for Okada, Keke & OEM Programmes
hero_alt: Motorcycle clutch assembly from the Autologic range for Nigerian buyers
hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer based in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for Nigeria. We export clutch systems, brake shoes, engine components and aluminium castings to importers, spare parts markets and assemblers.

Commercial motorcycles and keke tricycles carry passengers and goods across Nigerian cities and towns, often on rough roads and in dusty conditions. That kind of work wears clutches and brakes quickly, so dependable replacement parts matter. Browse the range below and open any product for details.

network.title: Why Nigerian Buyers Choose Us
paras: We have manufactured drivetrain parts for more than 25 years and test every component before dispatch.
Sourcing clutch, brake and casting lines from one manufacturer reduces the number of suppliers you manage and keeps quality consistent across your range.
Our team can review the part numbers your customers ask for most and suggest an opening range that covers the busiest motorcycle and keke repairs.

network.title: Shipping Parts to Nigeria
paras: Consignments travel by sea in palletised export packing, typically to the Lagos ports, with complete documents for your clearing agent.
We can mix motorcycle, tricycle and casting items in one container and plan repeat shipments so your stock stays balanced.
Cartons can be labelled by model and part number so stock is easy to check on arrival and quick to find in the market.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the Nigerian market?
cta.text: Send your part list, models or drawings with expected quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and prepare a quotation for delivery to Nigeria.

faq_intro: Quick answers for importers, traders and assemblers in Nigeria planning an order with Autologic Industries.
faqs: Do you supply both motorcycle and keke parts to Nigeria?
Yes. Our range covers two wheeler clutch parts, three-wheeler clutch and brake parts, engine components and aluminium castings.
Can I order a mixed container?
Yes. Motorcycle, tricycle and casting items can be combined in one shipment, packed and labelled by model.
Can you produce parts to our drawings?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC machining lines produce components from customer drawings or samples after a feasibility review.
How can I check quality before a large order?
Order samples of the parts you need. Once you approve fit and finish, volume production follows the same specification.
Do your brake shoes suit loaded tricycles?
Yes. Our three-wheeler drum brake shoes are designed for responsive stopping and short distances under full passenger loads.
